caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a barefoot person standing on a rectangular stone pedestal composed of four visible blocks. The person is dressed in a loose, draped garment with short sleeves and gathered fabric around the waist and legs, primarily colored in shades of gray with slight brownish tints. The figure’s left arm is bent at the elbow, holding a circular object, while the right arm hangs down. The person’s head is slightly tilted, with short, curly hair. The pedestal is shaded in tones of gray and brown, with defined edges and surface lines. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of a light beige color. The artist's name, Stanley Mazur, appears in small text near the bottom right corner.
title: Hitching Post
